# Owner Address Handling — Spring PetClinic REST at /home/daniel/sandbox

## Key finding: structured address is NOT yet implemented

The codebase currently uses a single **flat `address` string field**. The structured form (`addressLine1` / `addressLine2`) appears **only in the test files** (`AcceptanceTest.java` and helper methods in `AcceptanceBase.java`) as a target for a "later checkpoint." There is no `addressLine` field in the model, the entity, the OpenAPI schema, the DTO, or any function class yet. The request DTO `OwnerFieldsDto` is generated by the OpenAPI generator from `openapi.yml` (no Java source file exists for it in the repo).

---

## 1. Owner request DTO

The request body type is **`OwnerFieldsDto`**, generated at build time from the `OwnerFields` schema in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`. There is no hand-written Java file. The schema (lines 1991-2087) defines the editable fields:

- `firstName` (1-30, pattern letters)
- `lastName` (1-30, pattern letters)
- `address` (string, 1-255, example `'110 W. Liberty St.'`) — flat single field
- `city` (1-80)
- `telephone` (E.164-normalized)
- `email` (optional, format email)
- `postcode` (optional, `pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'`)
- `registrationDate`, `birthDate` (optional dates)
- `sharesHousehold` (boolean, create-time flag)
- `required: [firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone]`

The postcode description names the fixed region table: NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099.

---

## 2. Owner validation logic

Two function classes validate owners. Both bind `OwnerFieldsDto`.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerFields.java` (create pipeline, POST)
Collects errors for blank `firstName`, `lastName`, `address` (checked after `OwnerAddress.normalize`), `city`, `telephone` (converted to E.164 via `OwnerTelephone.toE164`), validates optional `email` (`OwnerEmail.isValid`/`isDisposable`, normalized lower-case), optional `postcode` (`OwnerRegion.isPostcodeValid(city, postcode)`), and `registrationDate` (not in future). Throws `OwnerFieldsInvalidException(List<String> errors)`. The normalized address replaces the submitted value: `request.setAddress(address)` (lines 40-46). Full contents already captured; key lines 36-80.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwner.java` (update pipeline, PUT)
Only validates the optional postcode against `OwnerRegion.isPostcodeValid(request.getCity(), postcode)`; throws `OwnerFieldsInvalidException(List.of("postcode"))`.

Also relevant — the JPA entity bean-validation constraints live on `Owner` (see #7): `@NotEmpty` on `address`, `city`, `telephone`; `@Pattern` E.164 on `telephone`.

Note: the only files in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/` are `PetAgeValidation.java` and `PetAgeValidator.java` — no owner validator there.

---

## 3. Household hash computation

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerHousehold.java`
Single source of truth. `householdId(String lastName, String postcode)`: returns `null` when postcode null/blank; otherwise key = `normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode.trim()`, SHA-256, then first **6 bytes formatted as upper-case hex = 12 hex chars**. `normalize(value)` = trim + collapse whitespace + lower-case. Full contents captured above.

Consumers:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignOwnerHousehold.java` — stamps `owner.setHouseholdId(OwnerHousehold.householdId(lastName, postcode))`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/CountOwnerHousehold.java` — sets `householdSize` by counting matching `householdId` across `ownerRepository.findAll()` + 1.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java` — rejects a second owner with the same `householdId` (409) unless `sharesHousehold == true`; null household id = no check.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerIdentity.java` — builds `identityKey` = `E164telephone|lowercaseEmail|householdId`.

---

## 4. Postcode validation

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerRegion.java`
`isPostcodeValid(String city, String postcode)` (lines 83-93): postcode must match `\d{4}`; if the city's region is known, value must fall in that region's inclusive range; a city with unknown region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Full contents captured above.

---

## 5. Locality code

Also in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerRegion.java`:
- `localityOf(String city, String postcode)` — prefers postcode's region (`regionForPostcode`), falls back to `regionOf(city)`.
- `regionOf`, `timezoneOf`, private `regionForPostcode`.

Read-time derivation in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (`@Named("locality")`, lines 70-76): locality = REGION segment of `customerCode` via `OwnerCustomerCode.region(...)`, falling back to `OwnerRegion.localityOf(city, postcode)`. `timezone` derives from locality. ---

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerAddress.java`
`normalize(String value)` — null→"", trim, collapse `\s+`→single space, upper-case (Locale.ROOT), then token-by-token abbreviation expansion: `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. This is the single source of truth for address normalization. Full contents captured above.

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerEmail.java` — `isValid`, `isDisposable`, `normalize` (lower-case).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerTelephone.java` — `toE164`, `toDisplay`.
- `OwnerHousehold.normalize` (lower-case form, used for lastName in hashing).

---

## 7. Owner entity class

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
`@Entity @Table(name="owners")` extends `Person`. Address-relevant columns: `address` (`@NotEmpty`), `city` (`@NotEmpty`), `telephone` (`@NotEmpty` + `@Pattern` E.164), `email`, `postcode`, plus derived/stored `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `householdId`, `householdSize`, `namesakeCount`, `membershipPoints`, `membershipLevel`, `bulkSignupWarning`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, and `pets`. A **single flat `address` String** — no `addressLine1/2`. Full contents captured above (308 lines).

---

## 8. Tests for owner request / validation / address / household / postcode / locality

Only three test files exist, all under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:

### `AcceptanceTest.java` (full contents captured above)
Class javadoc describes the `address-structured` checkpoint: "structured addressLine1/city/postcode is accepted and normalized (upper-case, collapse whitespace, expand ST->STREET), and 'address' is the composed normalized string. The flat 'address' form stays accepted (backward-compatible)."
- `coreNormalizesAndComposesStructuredAddress()`: builds `structuredOwner()`, sets `addressLine1="10 king st"`, removes `addressLine2`, creates owner, then asserts `$.addressLine1 == "10 KING STREET"` and `$.address == "10 KING STREET"`.
- `functionalityStillAcceptsFlatAddress()`: `createOwner(ownerNode())` expects 2xx.

These assert behavior that does NOT yet exist (no `addressLine1` field anywhere in main source) — they define the feature to build.

### `AcceptanceBase.java` (helpers captured above)
- `uniqueAddress()` → `seq() + " Test Street"`; `uniqueCity()` → `"Town"+seq()`.
- `ownerNode()` — flat valid owner with `address`, `city`.
- `withPostcode(o)` — adds `"postcode":"2000"`.
- `structuredOwner()` (lines 134-142) — removes `address`, adds `addressLine1 = seq()+" Test Street"` and `postcode "2000"`.
- Pinned reference tables mirroring `OwnerRegion`: `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES`; helpers `region(city)`, `timezone(city)`, `validPostcode(city)`, `knownOwner(city)`.
- Hash/identity replication: `sha256hex`, `shaHex(s,n)` (upper-case prefix), `luhn`.

### `AuditLogCapture.java`
Audit-log test utility (not address-specific).

---

## 9. OfficeFloor YAML files for owners

Under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/`:

### `rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (full contents captured above)
Create pipeline chain: `ValidateOwnerFields` → `CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique` → `CheckOwnerCityCapacity` → `CheckOwnerDailyLimit` → `BuildOwner` → `AssignOwnerHousehold` → `CountOwnerHousehold` → `AssignOwnerCustomerCode` → `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber` → `CountOwnerNamesakes` → `AssignOwnerMembershipLevel` → `FlagOwnerBulkSignup` → `FlagOwnerPossibleDuplicate` → `SaveOwner` → `AuditOwnerCreated` → `RespondWithOwnerCreated`. Authorized `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`.

### `rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` (full contents captured above)
Update chain: `ValidateOwner` → `LoadOwner` → `ApplyOwner` → `SaveOwner` → `RespondWithOwnerUpdated`.

### Other owner YAMLs (not address-specific)
- `rest/api/owners.GET.yml`, `rest/api/v2/owners.GET.yml`
- `rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml`, `rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml`
- `rest/api/owners/{ownerId}/pets.POST.yml`, `.../pets/{petId}.PUT.yml`, `.GET.yml`, `.../pets/{petId}/visits.POST.yml`

### Escalation (exception → handler) YAMLs
- `escalation/org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.OwnerFieldsInvalidException.yml` → `OwnerFieldsInvalidExceptionHandler` (400, JSON `{errors:[...]}`)
- `escalation/...OwnerHouseholdDuplicateException.yml` → `OwnerHouseholdDuplicateExceptionHandler` (409 Conflict)
- `escalation/...OwnerCityAtCapacityException.yml`, `...OwnerDailyLimitReachedException.yml`

### Exception + handler Java classes (captured above)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerFieldsInvalidException.java` (holds `List<String> errors`)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerFieldsInvalidExceptionHandler.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerHouseholdDuplicateException.java` (holds `householdId`)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerHouseholdDuplicateExceptionHandler.java`

---

## Summary of where changes would go to add structured address (addressLine1/addressLine2)

1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — `OwnerFields` schema (lines 2012-2018, the `address` property) to add `addressLine1`/`addressLine2`; regenerates `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`.
2. `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — add columns + getters/setters.
3. `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerAddress.java` — compose/normalize structured lines into the canonical `address`.
4. `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerFields.java` and `ApplyOwner.java` — handle the new fields.
5. `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — map/compose.
6. Possibly a DB schema/migration (not located in this pass — none referenced the address columns beyond JPA `@Column`).

The two acceptance tests in `AcceptanceTest.java` already encode the expected behavior.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation; it
                carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the owner's
                customerCode. Derived at read time from the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
              type: string
              example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 365 days. Tenure is measured from the
                registration date, so a newly created owner (zero tenure) never earns the tenure
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:

          readOnly: true

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object

          title: ID

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation; it
                carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the owner's
                customerCode. Derived at read time from the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
              type: string
              example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 365 days. Tenure is measured from the
                registration date, so a newly created owner (zero tenure) never earns the tenure
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
